verdict.rationale: Live probes show AnyDesk serves a working llms.txt at support.anydesk.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured Help Center index) and markdown versions of docs (.md endpoint with a documentation index), which is what an agent needs to consume its docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation or announcement of the llms.txt/markdown docs, evidence of how completely the index covers the knowledge base, independent user corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
